description: This file defines the VideoOutputPort class and its nested Display class, including member variables, methods, and related class declarations for managing video output port configurations and display properties in a device settings context.

classes.name: VideoOutputPort
classes.description: Represents a video output port with properties such as type, resolution, display info, and methods to access and modify these properties.

classes.name: VideoOutputPort::Display
classes.description: Encapsulates display-specific information such as product code, serial number, manufacturer details, HDMI physical address, and capabilities.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of VideoOutputPort, either by id or name.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the video output port.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the port.

methods.name: getIndex
methods.description: Returns the index of the port.

methods.name: getDisplay
methods.description: Returns display information associated with the port.

methods.name: isContentProtected
methods.description: Checks if content protection is enabled.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the port is enabled.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Checks if the port is active.

methods.name: isDynamicResolutionSupported
methods.description: Checks if dynamic resolution is supported.

methods.name: setAudioPort
methods.description: Sets the audio output port ID.

methods.name: setResolution
methods.description: Sets the resolution for the port.
